+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# ENHANCED_V1: Guard around pip install to handle repos without packaging metadata.
+# This script is invoked by the test harness to (re)install the repository.
+# It checks for packaging descriptors and adjusts the environment accordingly.
+
+set -e
+
+# Repository root path is expected to be provided via REPO_PATH environment variable.
+if [ -z "$REPO_PATH" ]; then
+    echo "ERROR: REPO_PATH environment variable is not set."
+    exit 1
+fi
+
+echo "Running repository setup for $REPO_PATH"
+
+# Detect packaging metadata
+if [ -f "$REPO_PATH/setup.py" ] || [ -f "$REPO_PATH/pyproject.toml" ]; then
+    echo "Packaging metadata found. Proceeding with pip install."
+    pip install "$REPO_PATH"
+else
+    # Additional check for a [project] section inside pyproject.toml (PEP 621)
+    if [ -f "$REPO_PATH/pyproject.toml" ] && grep -q "^\[project\]" "$REPO_PATH/pyproject.toml"; then
+        echo "PEP 621 [project] section detected. Proceeding with pip install."
+        pip install "$REPO_PATH"
+    else
+        echo "WARNING: No packaging metadata (setup.py, pyproject.toml, or [project] section) found."
+        # Install runtime dependencies if a requirements.txt is present
+        if [ -f "$REPO_PATH/requirements.txt" ]; then
+            echo "Installing dependencies from requirements.txt"
+            pip install -r "$REPO_PATH/requirements.txt"
+        fi
+        # Add repository root to PYTHONPATH so modules can be imported directly
+        export PYTHONPATH="${PYTHONPATH}:$REPO_PATH"
+        echo "Added $REPO_PATH to PYTHONPATH"
+    fi
+fi
